assistant_outcomes.text: Finding the conspiracy test lattice and wiring a continuous dig loop over it with Vast Ollama.
Implementing a continuous lattice dig loop over the conspiracy test preset, then starting it on Vast Ollama.
Background thread died when the CLI process exited. Fixing so `--bg` spawns a lasting process, then restarting the loop.

**Lattice loop is running** on your conspiracy test preset, digging with Vast `qwen2.5:14b`. ### What it loaded From `worktrees/sovereign-mirror-scaffold/data/presets/conspiracy_lattice.json` → **13 knots** (core rope → five-step → cases: JFK, Epstein, Seth Rich, etc.) ### Law every dig (baked in) Not courtroom proof · rhyme ≠ identity · residual open · no new church · multi-frame only ### What it’s doing (loop) 1. Dig next **knot** text 2. Ollama structure map + Mag-stealable method 3. Model proposes **public URLs** 4. Next cycles **follow those URLs** (self-directed) 5. Repeat until you stop
Loop is alive (cycle 4 done). Restarting with almost no pause between digs — time is money.
Fixing the lattice loop so digs finish fully and each result links into a Verkle-style chain (no truncation between cycles).
Updating the lattice loop: full digs finish before the next bead; each bead links into a local Verkle tip chain.

**Fixed and running.** Digs now **finish fully**, then the **next bead** links on a lattice Verkle tip — no mid-answer cut, no racing workers. ### What changed | Before | Now | |--------|-----| | Prompt sliced to 14k / “Concise” | Full dig gen (`num_predict=8192`, long ctx) | | Knot body cut at 12k | **Full knot text** | | No chain | **`verkle_chain.jsonl` + `verkle_tip.json`** | | Next dig ignored prior | Next dig loads **full previous dig file** as parent bead | | Many processes | Single detached worker | ### Live chain (already) | seq | unit | answer_chars | parent → root | |-----|------|--
Three lattice workers are racing — killing extras so one chain worker remains.

**Still running.** Snapshot: | | | |--|--| | Tunnel / Ollama | Up | | Lattice worker | Restarted (single chain process) | | Verkle beads | **3** linked (`parent_root` → new tip) | | Dig files | **12+** under `memory/improve/blast/lattice/digs/` | | Latest bead | `c0015_url_15` ~4k chars, full finish before next | | Mode | Finish dig → append bead → next URL/knot | **Rule in force:** no mid-answer cut; next unit starts only after the previous bead is written on the tip. Check anytime: ```powershell $env:OLLAMA_HOST = "http://127.0.0.1:11434" python main.py lattice-loop --status ``` Stop billing
